I make tools that improve my own day, then keep improving them in small steps. I work with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) and ship in small, tested increments.

## Projects

| Project | Description | Stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Mira** | Turkish-speaking desktop AI assistant for Windows. Voice, screen reading and 55 tools (windows, files, clipboard, Spotify, reminders). | Python, FastAPI, React, SQLite |
| **Beynim** | Shared, source-linked memory for AI coding agents, synced across devices with Git. | Python, Markdown, Git |
| **RITM** | Coached interval runs with optional Turkish voice cues and Health Connect / HealthKit. | Expo, React Native, TypeScript |
| **StreakRun** | Local-first running app with streaks, XP and rest days that don't break your streak. | Expo, React Native, SQLite |
| [**Network Interface Monitor**](https://github.com/KaizenDew/Network-Interface-Monitoring-Script) | Logs network interface stats (IP, netmask) into SQLite. Runs on WSL / Ubuntu. | Python, SQLite |

<sub>Only the network monitor is public for now. The other repositories are private.</sub>

## Stack

```text
Backend    Python (FastAPI), C# / .NET
Frontend   React, TypeScript, Vite
Mobile     React Native, Expo
Data       SQLite, PostgreSQL
AI         LLM tool calling, TTS / voice, local image generation (ComfyUI, FLUX)
Other      Git, Blender (low poly)
```

## Principles

- **Small steps.** One change at a time, verified before the next.
- **Local first.** Data stays on the device unless it has to leave.
- **Honest status.** If something isn't finished, it says so.
